items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs draw $517 million, ether pulls $189 million in biggest inflows in months
items.snippet: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $517 million and ether funds $189 million on Aug. 19, the strongest daily hauls in months, as a broad rally torched $2.7 billion in bearish bets.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC, ETH за ключовими словами.

items.title: HYPE jumps 20% as Trump signals legal US path for Hyperliquid
items.snippet: HYPE reached $72 after Trump said the CFTC was pursuing compliant US access for Hyperliquid, though no formal regulatory plan has been released.

items.title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
items.snippet: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

items.title: Bearish crypto bets lose record $2.7 billion as bitcoin surges toward $70,000
items.snippet: Traders betting against crypto lost $2.74 billion in a day, more than the short side of the October 2025 crash that remains the biggest liquidation event in the market's history.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
